subject: POC kickoff & ops cadence — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@novamed.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & ops cadence — next steps and owners

Hi Irene / Samir —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before kickoff: 

Summary from today's discovery
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for NovaMed clinical-document summarization pipeline (2M tokens/day peak).
- Success criteria (high level): 1) average 95th pct latency < 350ms for 1k-token requests, 2) F1 > 0.88 on masked-entity extraction for our evaluation set, 3) no PHI leakage in logs and KMS-backed encryption in transit & at rest.

Proposed POC scope and timeline (detailed in attached timeline):
- Kickoff & environment access: target 2027-06-21 (one-hour kickoff)
- Data prep & ingestion (sample dataset): complete by 2027-06-28
- Integration + initial run: 2027-06-29 to 2027-07-05
- Mid-readout (prelim metrics, tuning): 2027-07-12
- Final readout & decision: 2027-07-26

Ops cadence proposal
- Weekly 30-min check-ins (Wednesdays 10:00 PDT) for progress/troubleshooting
- Slack channel: #nova-poc (we'll create and invite your team)
- Owner model: Redwood infra lead + NovaMed data lead for each milestone (owners below)

Proposed owners (suggestions from our side)
- Redwood POC lead (technical): Aditya Rao — integration, playback, latency tuning
- Redwood product/quality: Lauren Bishop — evaluation metrics, regression checks
- NovaMed integration lead: Samir Patel — data access and ingestion

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Timeline_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners), Evaluation_Criteria_Master.docx

Please reply with any edits to success criteria or availability constraints. If that timeline looks good I'll send calendar invites for the kickoff and the weekly checks and loop in our infra folks for VPN/KMS access details.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@novamed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 19:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & ops cadence — next steps and owners

Thanks, Soojin — very clear, appreciate the level of detail. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Data access & PHI: We need your infra team to confirm that logs are disabled by default and that you support field-level redaction; we can't provide PHI to any third party without that. SOC2 evidence will be required (we'll send a security questionnaire tomorrow).

2) Success metric: The F1 target of 0.88 is acceptable as a starting bar. We will also measure hallucination rate on a 200-sample human-annotated set (threshold < 6%). Please add that to the evaluation doc.

3) Availability: Our data engineering lead (Samir) will be out 2027-06-24 through 2027-06-27. If kickoff is 2027-06-21 that's fine; however the main data handoff will need to happen the week of 6/28.

Assignees from our side:
- Product sponsor: Irene Choi
- Integration lead: Samir Patel (data eng)

We look forward to the kickoff. Please include a short pre-kickoff checklist (VPN creds, sample file format, test account) in the invite.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Head of Product, NovaMed
irene.choi@novamed.com

Subject: Re: POC kickoff & ops cadence — next steps and owners (owners + tech checklist)

Thanks all — adding technical owners and a short pre-kickoff checklist so we can remove blockers before the 21st.

Confirmed owners from Redwood:
- POC integration & latency tuning: Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwood.com)
- Eval suite and quality gates: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwood.com)
- Env & security (VPN/KMS/SOC evidence): Connor O'Brien (connor_obrien@redwood.com) — Connor will reach out separately with the SOC2 snapshot and the default logging controls.

Pre-kickoff tech checklist (Connor/Aditya action items)
- Create VPN access token + test account for NovaMed (creds to be delivered via DocuSign/secure channel) — due 2027-06-18
- Field-level redaction configuration checked and default logging disabled — confirm by 2027-06-18
- Sample ingestion script and expected CSV/JSON schema posted to shared Drive link — 2027-06-18
- Baseline eval harness (initial 200-sample hallucination set) added to Evaluation_Criteria_Master.docx — Lauren by 2027-06-20

Cadence / invites
- Kickoff: 2027-06-21 10:00 PDT / 1:00 EDT (60 minutes)
- Weekly check-ins: Wednesdays 10:00 PDT (30 minutes) starting 2027-06-30

I'll create calendar invites and a dedicated Slack channel (#nova-poc) after we confirm availability. If anyone needs a different cadence, flag it here.

Thanks — Aditya

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@novamed.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.com>

Great — thanks for the quick confirmations. I'm sending the calendar invites now (Kickoff 2027-06-21 10:00 PDT) and have attached the timeline + evaluation criteria. Connor, please share SOC2 snapshot and VPN delivery plan in-thread or via the Drive link.

Action items recap (owners & due dates)
- Connor: SOC2 snapshot + confirm logging defaults / VPN plan — due 2027-06-18
- Aditya: Provision test account & ingestion script — due 2027-06-18
- Lauren: Publish baseline eval set and hallucination rubric — due 2027-06-20
- Samir (NovaMed): Confirm dataset delivery slot week of 6/28

If there are no objections I'll create the Slack channel and add Execs for visibility. Looking forward to kickoff.

Regards,
Soojin
